name: Shattering Rune
disable: DC 30 Thievery check (master) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to dispel the rune

items.name: Shattering Shockwave
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature comes within 10 feet of the rune

---
Effect The rune unleashes a deafening peal of thunder that deals 10d8 sonic damage in a 20-foot burst (DC 30 basic Reflex save).

text: A magical rune is inscribed on the tarry earth at the entrance to the hut, buried beneath snow, with an Invisible sensor that detects creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere.
